name: ai-packs
description: Ready-to-use AI packs, one per job: Claude Code plugins and n8n workflows, each tested before release.

plugins.name: pr-squad
plugins.description: 8 Claude Code agents that review your branch before code review. Run /pr-squad:ship, or just ask for a PR.

plugins.name: invoice-chaser
plugins.description: 8 Claude Code agents that find the money freelancers are owed: bank reconciliation, tax and duplicate checks, one verified reminder per client. Run /invoice-chaser:chase, or just ask to chase your unpaid invoices.

plugins.name: post-recycler
plugins.description: 8 Claude Code agents that turn one post into 10 formats (X post and thread, Threads, Bluesky, carousel, Instagram, 30 s video, newsletter, quote card, story), then a script checks every limit and every number. Run /post-recycler:recycle, or just ask to repurpose your post.
